source.citation: Ekneligoda, T. C., Zimmerman, R. W. (2006). Compressibility of two-dimensional pores having n-fold axes of symmetry. Proceedings of the Royal Society A 462, 1933-1947.

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), read on the page text and compared with the image of the page
transcription.note: Normalized pore compressibility G Cpc / (1 - nu) of a hole in a plane-strain matrix of shear modulus G and Poisson ratio nu: the relative change of area of the hole under a unit hydrostatic stress in the plane; it is 2 for a circular hole. The holes are the images of the unit circle by a map which, written from the outside of the unit disk, is z = zeta + m1 zeta^(-2) (Table 4) or z = zeta + m1 zeta^(-2) + m2 zeta^(-5) (Table 5); the article writes the same maps from the inside of the disk. Table 3 gives regular polygons: the values of the article are extrapolated from maps of three and four terms, and computed by boundary elements. The coefficients are stored as decimal numbers: 1/9, 1/5, 1/3, 1/2, 1/15, 1/6, 2/15, 7/45.
